rationale: The plan correctly uses DESeq2 with design ~subject + condition, explicit control releveling, and Wald test on the condition coefficient, matching the paired design exactly, with an edgeR QL cross-check on the identical design as a bonus robustness layer. QC precedes testing with blind VST, PCA/heatmap colored by condition and subject, library size checks, and an explicit outlier-flagging policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=5 samples) is minimal and justified by group size; normalization is strictly internal to each model (DESeq2 median-of-ratios, edgeR TMM) with no pre-normalized counts fed into any model. BH-FDR at padj<0.05 is applied consistently with apeglm shrinkage reported alongside unshrunken LFC, and independent filtering/Cook's outliers are handled transparently. Enrichment is well-specified (full ranked list, Wald stat, named versioned collections, 15-500 size window, leading-edge reporting) though slightly more elaborate than strictly needed; the final report is thorough, naming methods, versions, thresholds, counts, and caveats.
